2608.13368.title: Sign Language Video Synthesis via Loss-Guided Multi-Expert GANs
2608.13368.paper_summary: This preliminary technical report presents a framework for sign language video synthesis using a loss-guided multi-expert Generative Adversarial Network (GAN) to enhance communication for individuals with hearing impairments. Three specialized discriminators -- global, hand, and head -- each guide a corresponding expert branch in the generator toward a distinct visual region, enabling implicit feature specialization without explicit diversity losses. To stabilize this multi-discriminator system, whose early-phase training otherwise exhibits chaotic dynamics, we introduce a United Loss consensus mechanism that regularizes each discriminator toward the ensemble average at a 10% weight. Each branch further adopts a dual-pathway convolutional-transformer design with learnable AdaptiveFeatureFusion, balancing the stability of convolutions against the detail of windowed self-attention. The generator is trained using an alternating three-mode schedule (discriminator, holistic generation, branch-specialized generation). On a custom 156GB dataset with a filtered test set that removes easy and repetitive samples, our 0.2B-parameter variant achieves 29.8 PSNR and the 1.3B-parameter variant achieves 30.7 PSNR, with inference VRAM footprints of 1.5 GB and 8 GB respectively, enabling deployment on consumer-grade hardware. Full ablation studies remain ongoing due to the 2-3 month training cycle on a single GPU. The system was showcased at the 2025 Hong Kong Frontier Technology Summit.
2608.13368.paper_summary_zh: 這份初步技術報告提出了一個手語視頻合成的框架，使用損失引導的多專家生成對抗網絡（GAN），以增強聽障人士的溝通能力。三個專門的判別器——全局、手部和頭部——各自引導生成器中的對應專家分支朝向不同的視覺區域，實現隱式特徵專門化，而無需明確的多樣性損失。為了穩定這個多判別器系統，因為其早期訓練階段會顯示出混亂的動態，我們引入了一個統一損失共識機制，將每個判別器的權重正則化到集成平均值的10%。每個分支進一步採用雙路徑卷積-Transformer設計，並具有可學習的自適應特徵融合，平衡卷積的穩定性與窗口自注意力的細節。生成器使用交替的三模式計劃進行訓練（判別器、整體生成、分支專門生成）。在一個自定義的156GB數據集上，經過過濾的測試集去除了簡單和重複的樣本，我們的0.2B參數變體達到了29.8 PSNR，而1.3B參數變體達到了30.7 PSNR，推理的VRAM佔用分別為1.5 GB和8 GB，能夠在消費級硬件上部署。由於在單個GPU上的訓練周期為2-3個月，完整的消融研究仍在進行中。該系統在2025年香港前沿科技峰會上展示。
